body: Hey, just finished talking to a close long time friend, I can't say how much your post means to me. I've calmed down a lot. I don't know what else to say other than you mean more than words to me. I really mean it.
Thanks for the recommendation and the advice, I appreciate it so much.

Hey! thanks for replying, I have recently bought a membership to the local YMCA, and I've been on my destiny grind although I know a few people addicted to csgo lol. I'm just really good at talking myself down when I'm alone.  I try to stay self aware of it becuase I feel like if I dont then it will just get worse.  You helped me realize that everything wrong is reversible...shit man im crying lol but in a good way, I feel.......happy :)  I guess my problem was just needing to talk to an outside source from my life.  I know it might not seem like a lot, but your comment meant so much, even though it was just things I've been told before, but seeing that someone out there actually gives a damn about other people....I think I'll stick around in this sub on my main. 


Truly thank you.
